title: Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Online Form 2026
postName: Engagement of Apprentices under Apprentices Act
vacancyDetails: Apprentice engagement in IOB branches/states as per bank notification
qualification: Graduation from a recognized university; local language proficiency as required
ageLimit: Typically 20 to 28 years as on cut-off date (check IOB notification)
selectionProcess: Online Test / Merit → Local Language Test → Document Verification → Engagement
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.iob.in Careers
2. Open Apprentice recruitment apply link
3. Register and fill form
4. Pay fee if applicable and submit
5. Download application printout
shortDescription: Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Online Form 2026 – apply for one-year apprenticeship on iob.in careers portal.
content:
Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has invited online applications for engagement of Apprentices under the Apprentices Act.

Candidates with graduation and prescribed age can apply through the bank careers page. Selection may include online test and local language assessment. Stipend is paid during the apprenticeship period as per notification.
